name: Sega Genesis Controller (Nintendo Switch Online)
notes: The three-button Sega Genesis controller for Nintendo Switch Online over Bluetooth. Over Bluetooth it reports 057E:2017, the SNES controller's PID, and the name MD/Gen Control Pad, and over USB 057E:201E (hid-nintendo.c joycon_read_info, darthcloud bt_traces Device ID records and inquiry names). Hosts tell it from the SNES controller by its device type, 0D. It serves the 170-byte Bluetooth HID descriptor every Switch Bluetooth pad serves (bt_traces Frontline capture). The pad's behavior is this profile's data, on switch-pro's mechanisms. Before a host speaks the protocol it sends the 12-byte 0x3F report with the D-pad as the hat and the four stick words at 0x8000, as the captures show, and B, A, C, Mode, Start, Home and Capture as buttons 1, 2, 6, 8, 10, 13 and 14 (BlueRetro sw.c). The protocol answers device type 0D. No capture holds a Genesis pad's device info: the byte after the type, 02, and the trailing 00 02 are what both captured NSO pads send, and the firmware 03 8B is switch-pro's. SPI reads answer from an image that is FF beside the device type, as the captured pad's reads are. After the handshake the 0x30 report carries A on the A bit, B on B, C on R, Mode on ZR and Start on Plus (hid-nintendo.c gencon_button_mappings), the stick bytes zero, 80 in byte 2 and 00 in byte 12. X, Y and Z belong to the six-button Mega Drive pad and are not on this one. The pad has no rumble. On the USB/IP backend the device presents genesis-nso-usb, 057E:201E, under this profile's id and strings (usbForm).
